sources.title: Realistic Snapshot (Z-Image-Turbo) | TensorHub Art
sources.snippet: Realistic Snapshot [Z-Image-Turbo] This LoRA adds raw texture, realistic skin details (pores/vellus hair), and natural lighting physics to Z-Image-Turbo. It is designed to remove the "plastic" AI look and works for candid "camera roll" snapshots and it also kinda works for high-end professional shots for general realism boost.
